# Waimind.com — Healthy Western Recipes

> A curated library of low-calorie Mediterranean and Western recipes. Every serving is 400-600 kcal with at least 15g of protein. Recipes are developed, tested, and nutrition-verified by our editorial kitchen.

## Site info

- **URL**: https://waimind.com
- **Owner**: Healthy Recipes Editorial
- **Recipes published**: 167

- **Update cadence**: 1 new recipe daily
- **Language**: English
- **Cuisine focus**: Mediterranean, Italian, Greek, Spanish, French, Turkish
- **Specialties**: Low-calorie (400-600 kcal/serving), high-protein (>=15g), gluten-free and dairy-free options
- **Licensing**: Content may be cited with attribution to waimind.com
